summary: The proposed HG-BACKFILL-FIDELITY-CAPACITY-EXACTNESS leaf is stale against the newer reviewed HG-FIDELITY-REGISTRATION-CAPACITY-CEILING lineage: the former requires maxRegisteredEntities=9007199254740991 to be accepted, while the latter intentionally establishes a project-owned maximum of 65536. Activating both as written would force a future worker either to violate the exactness leaf acceptance or regress the reviewed safety ceiling.

The retained #419 source validator rejects any maxRegisteredEntities above MAX_REGISTERED_ENTITIES before manager construction or pure-policy evaluation, so the older exactness leaf's required acceptance at 9007199254740991 is no longer satisfiable by design.

The newer queued Fidelity leaves HG-FIDELITY-MANAGER-STATE-ENCAPSULATION and HG-FIDELITY-CONFIG-CLOSED-SHAPE already depend on the capacity-ceiling lineage and should retain that 65536 contract; no runtime/product edit is warranted from this mining slot.
